content.title: About
content.content: Soup, cream of vegetable (4867) is a ready‑to‑eat vegetable cream soup made from selected vegetables, cream, and aromatic spices. It has a smooth texture, mild creamy flavor, and is suitable as a light starter or snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Vegetable cream soup is often used in diet nutrition because of its low calorie content and high vitamin levels.
The blend typically includes carrot, pumpkin, broccoli, and cauliflower, providing a wide range of nutrients.
The creamy base softens the taste and helps absorb fat‑soluble vitamins more effectively.
The product can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days after opening.
Some versions add herbs such as basil and parsley to enhance aroma.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: The vegetables provide vitamins B6 and B9, which support metabolism and the nervous system.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber improves digestion, promotes satiety, and supports gut health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The creamy component contains a modest amount of healthy fats, making the soup suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Beta‑carotene and vitamin C from the vegetables help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C and other micronutrients contribute to a stronger immune system.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cream component may trigger reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some varieties contain added salt; individuals monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Preservative content
items.content: Ready‑made soups may contain preservatives; those sensitive should choose a product without additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the vegetable cream soup over low heat, stirring, until it reaches 70‑80 °C. It can be served on its own, or enriched with cooked chicken pieces, seafood, or fresh herbs for variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C. After opening, consume within 5 days. Freezing may alter texture, so refrigeration is recommended.
